senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נָסָה)to lift up, carry.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 35a:16">Sot. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ ארון את נוֹשְׂאָיו</he> the Ark carried its carriers.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 6">Ab. ch. VI</cite> <he>נוֹשֵׂא בעול וכ׳</he> helps his brother to bear his yoke.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 3:1">Ber. III, 1</cite> <he>נוֹשְׂאֵי המטה</he>, v. <cite ref="M00968"><he>מִטָּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Megillah 9a:15">Meg. 9ᵃ</cite> (one of the changes in translating the Bible into Greek) <he>נוֹשֵׂא בני אדם</he> a carrier of men (for <cite ref="H01163"><he>חֲמֹר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Exodus 4:20">Ex. IV, 20</cite>); a. v. fr.—
Pesik. R. s. 6 אני מרומם ונושא את ראשם I will raise and elevate their head; v. infra.—נ׳ כפים, v. כַּף.—נ׳ פנים to lift up the face, to respect, favor, spare, be partial.

<cite ref="Chagigah 14a:11">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>נשוא פנים</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:3">Is. III, 3</cite>) <he>זה שנוֹשְׂאִין פ׳ לדורו בעבורו</he> he for whose sake his generation is favored in heaven.
<cite ref="Shabbat 13b:1">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא נ׳ פ׳ לתורה</he> who spared him not for the sake of his scholarship.
<cite ref="Yoma 87a:2">Yoma 87ᵃ</cite> <he>שנָשְׂאוּ לו פ׳ בעה״ז</he> that indulgence was shown him (by the Lord) in this world.

Num. R. s. 11 לא אֶשָּׂא פ׳ מפניך shall I not favor thee for thy own sake? Ib. כשם שהם נוֹשְׂאִין לי וכ׳ as they (the Israelites) honor me (by saying grace even after a scanty meal), so do I favor them; a. fr.—נ׳ נפש אל to lift up the soul to, to long for.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XXV, 1 למה אתה נושא נפשך אלי why dost thou lift up thy soul to me (why dost thou depend on me)?; Yalk. ib. 701.—נ׳ קרבן to offer up a sacrifice.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 702:1">Ib. 702</cite> <he>אדם חוטא ונושא ק׳</he> if a man sinned, he offered &c.; Midr. Till. l. c. <he>נושא ומביא ק׳</he> (corr. acc.)—Part. pass. <cite ref="N01293"><he>נָשׂוּא</he></cite>, f. <he>נְשׂוּאָה</he> &c. Ib. <he>עכשו … הרי נפשנו נ׳ לך</he> now that we have no sacrifices, our soul is lifted up to thee.

senses.gloss: to lift, remove. Pesik. R. l. c. (ref. to the double meaning of נ׳, to raise a. to remove) לכו שְׂאוּ את ראשו go and remove (or lift up) his head; a. fr.—נ׳ עון to forgive.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:1:7">Y. Snh. X, beg., 27ᶜ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 34:7">Ex. XXXIV, 7</cite>) <he>נושא עוונות אין וכ׳</he> the text does not say, ‘removing iniquities’, but ‘removing iniquity’, the Lord takes away (from the scales) one bond of man’s sins, and the merits prevail &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:57">Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ</cite> bot. (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 400:2">Yalk. Ex. 400</cite>; v. <cite ref="U00768"><he>שְׁטַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 45:1">Pesik. R. s. 45</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to take, esp. נ׳ ונתן to take and give, to deal; to transact, argue.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 31a:11">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>נָשָׂאתָ ונתת באמונה</he> hast thou (while on earth) been dealing honestly? <cite ref="Bava Metzia 48a:2">B. Mets. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>הנושא ונותן בדברים</he> he who concludes a bargain verbally. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 18 <he>כשם שנושאין ונותנין בהלכה וכ׳</he> as well as they debate on the law below, so do they above.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 48a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>שנושאין ונותנין בדין וכ׳</he> they argue in court, and the Lord argues with them; a. fr.

senses.gloss: נ׳ אשה, or נ׳ to take a wife into one’s house, to marry.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 2:1">Keth. II, 1</cite> <he>בתולה נְשָׂאתַנִי</he> thou hast married me as a virgin; <he>אלמנה נְשָׂאתִיךְ</he> I married thee as a widow.
<cite ref="Yevamot 37b:18">Yeb. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יִשָּׂא אדם וכ׳</he> one may not marry in one country and go away &c.

M. Kat. I, 7 אין נושאין נשים וכ׳ no marriages may take place during the festive week; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. נָשׂוּי (followed by accus.) having married; f. נְשׂוּאָה (followed by ל) being married to; pl. נְשׂוּאִים, … אִין; נְשׂוּאוֹת.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 3:6">Yeb. III, 6</cite> <he>ואחד נ׳ נכרית</he> one of them has married a stranger.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 3:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ומתו הנ׳ את האחיות</he> and those brothers who had married two sisters died. Ib. I, 2 (2ᵇ) <he>היתה … נשואה לאחיו</he> Y. ed. (Mish. ed. <he>נשואת</he>, corr. acc.; Bab. ed. <he>נשואות</he>) if his daughter or … was married to &c.; a. fr.—Tosef. ib. VI, 5 <he>נָשׂאוּי</he>.

senses.gloss: to be lifted up, removed &c. Pesik. R. l. c. כבר … שיִנָּשְׂאוּ את ראשם וכ׳ it had been decreed that their head should be lifted (v. supra): turn its meaning and elevate their head.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:1">Keth. I, 1</cite> <he>בתולה נ׳ וכ׳</he> a virgin’s marriage takes place on the fourth day of the week.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:2">Ib. V, 2</cite> <he>הגיע … ולא נִשְּׂאוּ</he> if the time set for marriage expired and they were not taken in marriage.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 2:10">Yeb. II, 10</cite> <he>מותרות לִינָּשֵׂא להם</he> they may marry them.
<cite ref="Yevamot 88b:3">Ib. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>הרי זו לא תִנָּשֵׂא ואם ניסת וכ׳</he> she must not marry again, and if she does &c.; <cite ref="Ketubot 22b">Keth. 22ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to lift up, to announce by signals (the New Moon).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:2">R. Hash. II, 2</cite>, a. e. <he>מַשִּׂיאִין</he>, v. <cite ref="M02817"><he>מַשּׂוּאָה</he></cite>. Y. ib. II, 58ᵃ top <he>אין משיאין לילי זמנו</he> we do not raise signals in the night of the regular New Moon (from the 29<sup>ᵗʰ</sup> to the 30<sup>ᵗʰ</sup>) &c.; a. fr.—Tosef. ib. II (I), 2 <he>מַסִּיעִין את החדש</he> ed. Zuck. (<he>משיא׳ על</he>, <he>מסיא׳</he>) we signalize the New Moon.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:11">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> (ref. to <he>ישא</he>, Ps. IXXV, 5) <he>יַשִּׂיא ברכה לאחרים</he> he will bring blessing upon others.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:7">Bets. III, 7</cite> <he>מַשִּׂיאָהּ על גבי חברתה</he> he may pass one knife over the other (to whet it).

<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 10:5">Tosef. Par. X</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 9:3">IX</cite>), 3 <he>הִשִּׂיאוֹ לדבר אחר</he> he diverted his mind towards another subject; <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:5">Ab. Zar. II, 5</cite>. Y. ib. II, 41ᶜ bot. <he>היה לו להַשִּׂיאוֹ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00919"><he>הֶשֵּׂיאָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 8:6">Tosef. Sot. VIII, 6</cite> <he>הִשִּׂיאוּ את הכתב וכ׳</he> they transcribed the inscription on the stones in seventy languages; <cite ref="Sotah 35b:1">Sot. 35ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. VII, 21ᵈ bot.

senses.gloss: to give away in marriage; to cause to marry.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 111b:7">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המַשִּׂיא בתו וכ׳</he> he who marries his daughter to a scholar.
<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:1">Ib. 67ᵇ</cite> top <he>מַשִּׂיאִין את היתומה וכ׳</he> we must first help the fatherless maiden to marry, and then the fatherless lad.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 29a:10">Kidd. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>האב חייב … ולהַשִּׂיאוֹ אשה</he> a father is bound to …, and to provide a wife for him; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be raised; to exalt one’s self, to boast.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 44a:7">Ab. Zar. 44ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00575"><he>הָלַם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 63b:20">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>להִתְנַשֵּׂא</he>, v. <cite ref="N00091"><he>נָבַל</he></cite>; a. e.
